text:
Stop dumping all data into S3 and calling it a lake. Analytics performance dies without distinct storage classes and lifecycle policies. Choose the layer before you write the Spark code.

#DataEngineering #AWS #BestPractices #TechTips
topic: Choosing the right AWS storage layer for analytics workloads
